user_goal.text: Set the user's weekday wake-up alarm snooze to 5 minutes.

benchmark_success.rationale: TestTracker success requires every registered test to pass.

checked_by.text: The official AppWorld evaluator runs six registered TestTracker checks covering the submitted answer and the retained start/end model changes.

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained submitted answer and official evaluator comparison result
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained evaluator result show that the registered answer-comparison test passed?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained start/end database diff and official TestTracker results
decisive_artifacts.question: Do the retained diff and results show that only phone.Alarm changed, with no alarms added or removed and exactly alarm id 295 updated solely in snooze_minutes to 5?

success_if.text: [appworld_test_001_844d21b309f0] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert answers match.
success_if.rationale: The evaluator compares the retained submitted answer with the official answer value null.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_002_5a61ba267558] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert model changes match phone.Alarm.
success_if.rationale: The evaluator requires the changed-model-name set to equal phone.Alarm.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_003_fa0ce68e2320] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: obtain added, updated, removed phone.Alarm records using models.changed_records, and assert 0 were added or removed, and 1 was updated.
success_if.rationale: The evaluator checks the three phone.Alarm change counts.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_004_45f9fa98e7f9] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert the updated alarm's id matches private_data.wake_up_alarm_id.
success_if.rationale: The evaluator requires the updated alarm id to equal 295.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_005_8e43d49f2ed2] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert the only changed field name in the updated alarm is "snooze_minutes" using models.changed_field_names.
success_if.rationale: The evaluator requires the changed-field-name set to contain only snooze_minutes.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_006_46eedd8b4145] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert the updated alarm's snooze_minutes matches public_data.snooze_minutes.
success_if.rationale: The evaluator requires the updated snooze_minutes value to equal 5.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_001_844d21b309f0] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert answers match.
fail_if.rationale: A submitted-answer mismatch fails this registered test.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_002_5a61ba267558] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert model changes match phone.Alarm.
fail_if.rationale: Any changed-model-name set other than exactly phone.Alarm fails this registered test.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_003_fa0ce68e2320] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: obtain added, updated, removed phone.Alarm records using models.changed_records, and assert 0 were added or removed, and 1 was updated.
fail_if.rationale: Any required phone.Alarm change-count mismatch fails this registered test.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_004_45f9fa98e7f9] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert the updated alarm's id matches private_data.wake_up_alarm_id.
fail_if.rationale: An updated alarm id other than 295 fails this registered test.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_005_8e43d49f2ed2] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert the only changed field name in the updated alarm is "snooze_minutes" using models.changed_field_names.
fail_if.rationale: Any changed field other than or in addition to snooze_minutes fails this registered test.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_006_46eedd8b4145] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert the updated alarm's snooze_minutes matches public_data.snooze_minutes.
fail_if.rationale: An updated snooze_minutes value other than 5 fails this registered test.

undecided_if.text: Undecided only if retained evidence cannot determine one or more frozen registered-test outcomes.
undecided_if.rationale: A registered-test outcome must not be inferred when its decisive retained evidence is missing or non-decisive.
